test_fresh_peer_needs_acceptance_progres: A new peer may consume after proven acceptance progress even when its acceptance hook coalesced.
test_queued_duplicate_accepts_without_qu: A queued duplicate is accepted without growing the queue or changing first-received fire intent.
test_empty_array_has_no_endpoints_but_no: Malformed received headers (empty/nondictionary arrays) can be observed and rejected before a later valid accepted packet.
test_hidden_metadata_calls_stay_inside_o: Newly counted hidden call timestamps lie in the preceding/current observation interval, including inclusive endpoints.
test_live_binding_round_epoch_change_kee: Round epoch advance with a live binding does not explain clearing the cumulative input-stream rejection state.
test_only_fully_exposed_batches_need_a_f: One/two-command headers expose all endpoints; count>=3 may contain an unexposed fresh middle despite stale endpoints.
test_queue_window_bound_includes_valid_f: Queue120 is legal; source backlog discard/pop and later tick remain valid, while queue121 is impossible.
test_rejection_state_and_calls_agree_in_: Stream rejection state and rejection observation counts constrain each other through a live stream.
test_single_command_is_fresh_and_inside_: For ACK1, seq2 and121 are legal fresh one-command inputs; seq1 and122 are invalid.
test_unchanged_metadata_can_remain_older: Unchanged counted metadata may remain older than the latest observation interval.
test_zero_peer_lobby_reset_retains_histo: A zero-bound guest reset replaces stream state while diagnostic rejection history persists; subsequent rejection increments both appropriately.
test_delayed_selected_stream_uses_its_ow: Delayed selected stream A uses A-owned acceptance/pop projections despite global latest belonging to stream B.
test_epoch_boundary_uses_acceptance_epoc: No-pop epoch changes distinguish old accepted data cleared by reset from new-epoch accepted receipts retained after reset.
test_explicit_unselected_pop_is_inferred: A sole known foreign-stream pop may update that stream even when another peer is selected.
test_exposed_queue_pops_oldest_instead_o: Sorted queue pop consumes the oldest command, not necessarily the latest accepted packet endpoint.
test_hidden_accept_before_hidden_pop_use: Known hidden acceptance-before-pop timing selects the pre-pop ACK interval.
test_large_duplicate_batch_cannot_erase_: A large duplicate batch must preserve earlier per-sequence immutable controls.
test_multi_peer_forced_flow_passes_but_a: Forced multi-peer ownership can pass while truly ambiguous accepted-header ownership remains UNKNOWN.
test_receipt_aggregate_retains_one_joint: Action aggregates and successive pops must share one feasible persistent payload assignment, including hidden pops.
test_same_stream_ack_and_queue_need_corr: Same-stream ACK/queue changes need corresponding accepted/pop/skipped calls.
test_shared_accepted_validation_covers_h: Hidden accepted headers satisfy the same count/epoch/window/freshness constraints as direct accepted hooks.
test_fresh_generation_after_retirement_c: After retirement/forget, a fresh generation may reuse the same peer number and actor.
